The book was gathered over thirty years from public and private records and from the family.
It builds on Harry M. Morgan's 1936 research, letters kept by Frank W. Hutchins of Lakeview Farm,
DePeyster, New York, John Bockus Hutchins of Toronto, and Doctor Edwin C. Byam of Suffield,
Connecticut, who had records of the Winchester branch.
The compiler's thanks end with a wife and children who spent family holidays in "dusty court house basements" and
old cemeteries hunting the missing link.
